coverage_note: Scratch transcript readers/flash/2026-10-02.txt. 00:02-06:40 and 54:16-1:04:06 are mostly English meta talk; 17:00-31:50 and 32:00-50:00 are an أول/تاني/آخر/غير/نفس position drill with many rule questions (questions not written as slips). Several Medi stretches come out in Latin (qayril yom, biddna tayir aklin, nafs il ishi). data/lesson-work/echo-candidates/ does not exist in this repo, so no echo/take_verb/chat_pairs list was read; by hand: 09:44 أطلع after أخد = engine for عطلة (aa5ud 3otle, her chat); 07:34 عشا = عشرة (time answer); 43:06 'إنتي غير هذا' = probably غير حدا (her chat 8eir 7ada), not written; 43:16 حاجة = حدا (her echo تاني حدا); 43:20 هذا الثاني = حدا التاني (her echo). Not written: 10:43 بخطط self-fixed to خططت; 16:06 تنتين وربع self-fixed; 45:01 عشر/عشرة question (he said عشر first); 45:55 الآخر self-fixed; 26:26 تانية question; 51:15 hada/hadi nafs el-ishi question; 1:04:01 أشوفك/شوفك farewell. Several PROPOSE rows share one tool-word rule (before vs after the noun, el- placement) taught this lesson.

rows.medi_said: أنا سمعت / متأخر اليوم. صحيت. That's right.
rows.why: He said سمعت (I heard) for 'I woke up'; her صحيت at 07:06 lands inside his 07:04 line, which he repeats and confirms with 'That's right' (GR-24).

rows.medi_said: أأأ، أنا صحيت تأخير
rows.why: Noun تأخير (delay) used for the adjective 'late' (sheet: late | Met2a55ar | متأخر); her voiced recap at 08:35 gives متأخر and he repeats it at 08:39, but the recap is late and may only be prompting him on.

rows.medi_said: آآآ على عشا (engine wrote على عشا; he said على عشرة)
rows.why: Answer to 'ay sa3a?' is a time, so عشا is the engine for عشرة (GR-25); her whole reply is 'el' and he fixes to على العشرة.

rows.medi_said: Okay أنا شوي-- أنا كان قنيش شوي--
rows.why: kaan not conjugated for 'I'; she recasts أنا كنت and he repeats it at 08:01.

rows.medi_said: هاد الصبح (also 08:54 هادي الصباح, 08:58 عاد الصباح)
rows.amal_said: We never say هذا الصبح just say الصبح or بالصباح.
rows.proposed_rule: 'This morning' is just el-subu7 / bil-sabaa7, never hada el-subu7 (Amal: we never say هذا الصبح).
rows.why: He calqued English 'this morning' with هاد; she says outright we never say هذا الصبح.
rows.english: I was a bit lazy this morning.

rows.medi_said: أنا لا مش / شجاع اليوم. مش شجاع اليوم.
rows.chat: lissa mish mitshajje3 lalshu9ul? / ana la mish mitshajje3
rows.why: She had just asked متشجع (motivated); he answered with شجاع (brave), a different form of the root, and she recast متشجع.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم / آآآ عطلة و
rows.why: laazem went straight to the noun عطلة; she supplies the verb in English ('you should take') and he says لازم أخد (GR-27).
rows.english: I need to take a vacation.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم أخد أطلع وسفر، سفر. (engine wrote أطلع for عطلة)
rows.why: Noun سفر (travel) used where the verb is needed; her English rephrase 'I should travel' (PG-22) makes him say لازم أسافر at 09:57, matching her typed asaafer.
rows.english: I have to take a vacation and travel.

rows.medi_said: أنا خططت / امم / سفر، / سفرة
rows.why: خطط needs la- before what is planned; she prompts 'You plan for' and he produces لَسَفَر at 11:07 (her chat la-safra).

rows.medi_said: بس أنا راح / آآآ على / عند / عموي.
rows.why: ra7 with no verb after it; she says 'Sorry بس أنا راح وقت', then 'What's going?', and he says راح أروح at 11:52.
rows.english: But I'm going to my uncle's for work.

rows.medi_said: آآآ على / عند
rows.amal_said: Either على or عند which one؟ Can't put two.
rows.why: He stacked two prepositions على عند; she says outright you can't put two, and he keeps عند at 12:18.

rows.medi_said: عموي. (again 12:18 عند عموي)
rows.why: عموي is a made-up form of عم (sheet: uncle (paternal) | 3am | عم); she recasts عمي twice and he says 'That's right'; first use 11:24, fixed once after the repeat.

rows.medi_said: How do I say we will have fun, Rah? / راح بدها؟
rows.amal_said: No. It's the whole-- It's the reason of our whole one month long lesson.
rows.why: He asked how to say 'we will have fun' and guessed بدها; she said No and hinted 'we will get happy', and he reached ننبسط (13:47) which she confirmed.

rows.medi_said: تش... تشكيل؟ / Tesh-- Was it tesh-- What was it?
rows.amal_said: So خيمة is a tent. That's the only hint.
rows.why: He forgot 'camping' (sheet: camping | ta5yeem | تخييم), tried تشكيل and asked; she gave the خيمة hint and he got تخييم at 14:55.

rows.medi_said: Asha Alfayn Sitwa Ashrin (engine Latin)
rows.chat: elyoam yoam el-jum3a talat 3ashara alafain u sitte u 3eshreen
rows.why: In the date he said 'asha' for 3ashar (13th); she echoed عشاء (dinner) and asked what it is, and he said عشرة at 15:44; could be a dropped ر (S4) rather than a word slip.

rows.medi_said: and if I say الأول الساعة, that means the f-- the, the... I thought you said this was also the first
rows.amal_said: Okay. / Nothing. / It would be the first if the أول is after.
rows.why: He put el-أول before the noun to mean 'the first hour'; she says it means nothing and the adjective must come after; part rule-talk, so medium.

rows.medi_said: Okay, so الساعة الأول.
rows.why: Feminine ساعة needs the feminine adjective أولى; she recasts أولى right after his الساعة الأول.

rows.medi_said: and التاني الساعة means a different hour.
rows.amal_said: لا. We can't say تاني الساعة. It doesn't mean anything.
rows.chat: taani saa3a = second hour / second hour
rows.why: He put el-تاني in front of el-ساعة; she says flatly it can't be said (the front word takes no el-); offered as his rule reading, so medium.

rows.medi_said: هذي اليوم التانية.
rows.amal_said: مم، مم، هذي اليوم. / مرة، هذي المرة.
rows.chat: hadi el-marra el-tania illi bashufek elyoam
rows.why: For 'this is the second time' he said اليوم (the day) instead of المرة (the time); she echoes هذي اليوم then supplies هذي المرة and he rebuilds with المرة.
rows.english: This is the second time (I see you today).

rows.medi_said: Uh, so ساعة الأول-- it should be ساعة الأول. ساعة الـ... ساعة أـ...
rows.chat: awal el-sa3a = the b eginning of the hour.
rows.why: Noun without el- before el-adjective and masculine أول for feminine ساعة; she recasts أولى then الساعة الأولى.

rows.medi_said: الأول الـ اليوم / 31:01 الأول اليوم
rows.why: For 'the beginning of the day' he put el- on أول in front of اليوم; she says 'Nothing' twice (she had given أول اليوم at 30:41).

rows.medi_said: مرة الأخيرة.
rows.why: Noun phrase needs el- on the noun as well as the adjective; she recasts المرة الأخيرة and he repeats it.

rows.medi_said: qayril yom." "Qayril yom." I'll see you another day.
rows.chat: bashufek 8eir yoam = i'll see you another day
rows.proposed_rule: Tool words (أول / آخر / تاني / غير / نفس) before a noun never take el-; the meaning comes from the noun and the position: غير takes a bare noun, never el-: غير يوم (Amal: غير يوم is way more common).
rows.why: He keeps saying 'ghayr il-yom' with el- (also 38:11); she recasts غير يوم; engine Latin, so the el- may be a linking vowel.

rows.medi_said: ال، الختيارة / الـ / أول؟ Is it أول؟
rows.why: Feminine ختيارة needs الأولى; he said أول (as a question) and she supplied الأولى, he answered 'goddammit, أولى'.

rows.medi_said: Yes, uh, tan-- uh, تاني، / تاني حاجة. (engine wrote حاجة; she echoes تاني حدا)
rows.amal_said: تاني حدا would mean the second person.
rows.proposed_rule: Tool words (أول / آخر / تاني / غير / نفس) before a noun never take el-; the meaning comes from the noun and the position: تاني in front means 'second' (تاني حدا = the second person); for 'someone else' put it after: حدا تاني.
rows.why: He wanted 'someone else' but put تاني in front, which she says means 'the second person'.

rows.medi_said: Oh, you're right. Uh, هذا الثاني. (she echoes حدا التاني)
rows.amal_said: حدا التاني is / no. X. Just حدا تاني.
rows.proposed_rule: Tool words (أول / آخر / تاني / غير / نفس) before a noun never take el-; the meaning comes from the noun and the position: after a noun meaning 'else / other' تاني has no el-: حدا تاني, not حدا التاني.
rows.why: Her echo shows he said حدا التاني (engine wrote هذا الثاني); she says 'no. X. Just حدا تاني'.

rows.medi_said: الأخيرة. No، wait. دقيقة is, is masculine. So، أخ-أخير.
rows.why: After the plural دقايق the adjective is plural الأخيرات; he switched to masculine أخير and she recast أخيرات.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, آخر الموظفة, right?
rows.chat: min aa5er muwazzafe/a / min el-muwazzafa el-a5ira
rows.proposed_rule: Tool words (أول / آخر / تاني / غير / نفس) before a noun never take el-; the meaning comes from the noun and the position: آخر + bare noun = the last X (آخر موظفة); آخر + el-noun = the end of X (آخر الاجتماع).
rows.why: Her English rephrase 'The end of the employees?' shows what آخر الموظفة means; he fixes to مين آخر موظفة at 47:12.

rows.medi_said: So، إحنا عندنا، / غير / you say it was dwarf? What was it again?
rows.why: He did not have the word for guests mid-sentence and asked; she supplied ضيوف and he used it.
rows.english: We have different guests every day.

rows.medi_said: أنا بسوق / نفس الطريقة
rows.chat: ana basoo2 nafs el-taree2 kul yom
rows.why: طريقة is 'way / method' (sheet: way / method | Tariqa | طريقة), not 'route' (sheet: road / way / route | 6ariq | طريق); she recasts طريق and he says نفس الطريق.
rows.english: I drive the same route every day.

rows.medi_said: القانون لغير مش نفس ال-- / uh, إشي من / نفس.
rows.proposed_rule: Tool words (أول / آخر / تاني / غير / نفس) before a noun never take el-; the meaning comes from the noun and the position: نفس goes in front and the noun takes el-: نفس الإشي, never إشي من نفس.
rows.why: He ended with إشي من نفس; she prompted 'Or مش نفس...', then said صح to his question and he said مش نفس الإشي; her صح may cover his first try, so low.
rows.english: The rule for ghair is not the same thing.
